```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
```

Print only 5 lines of each tibble:
```{r}
options(tibble.print_min = 5)
```

load dataset and clean variable names
```{r}
pulse_df = 
  haven::read_sas("./data/public_pulse_data.sas7bdat") |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

pulse_df
```

# 'Pivot_longer'
```{r}
pulse_tidy_df= 
  pivot_longer(
    pulse_df, 
    bdi_score_bl:bdi_score_12m, 
    names_to = "visit",
    values_to = "bdi")

pulse_tidy_df
```

```{r}
pulse_tidy_df=
  pivot_longer(
    pulse_df, 
    bdi_score_bl:bdi_score_12m,
    names_to = "visit",
    names_prefix = "bdi_score_",
    values_to = "bdi")

pulse_tidy_df
```

```{r}
mutate(pulse_tidy_df, visit= replace(visit, visit== "bl", "00m"), visit= factor(visit))
```


## Practice

load litters data set and clean variable names
```{r}
litters_df= read_csv("./data/FAS_litters.csv") |> 
  janitor::clean_names()
```

retain only litter number and weights in dataset
```{r}
select(litters_df, litter_number, gd0_weight,gd18_weight) |> 
  pivot_longer(gd0_weight:gd18_weight, 
               names_to = "gd",
               values_to = "weight") |> 
  mutate(
    gd= recode_values(gd, 
                "gd0_weight" ~ 0,
                "gd18_weight" ~ 18))
  
```

# 'Pivot_wider'
create a sample dataset
```{r}
analysis_result= 
  tibble(
    group= c("treatment", "treatment", "placebo", "placebo"),
    time= c("pre", "post", "pre", "post"),
    mean= c(4, 8, 3.5, 4)
  )

analysis_result
```
```{r}
pivot_wider(analysis_result, 
            names_from = "time", 
            values_from = "mean") |> 
  knitr::kable()
```

# Binding Rows

load data
```{r}
fellowship_ring= 
  readxl::read_excel("./data/LotR_Words.xlsx", range= "B3:D6") |> 
  mutate(movie= "fellowship_ring")

two_towers=
  readxl::read_excel("./data/LotR_Words.xlsx", range = "F3:H6") |> 
  mutate(movie= "two_towers")

return_king=
  readxl::read_excel("./data/LotR_Words.xlsx", range= "J3:L6") |> 
  mutate(movie= "return_king")
```

```{r}
lotr_tidy= bind_rows(fellowship_ring, two_towers, return_king) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  pivot_longer(female:male, 
               names_to = "gender",
               values_to = "words") |> 
  mutate(race= str_to_lower(race)) |> 
  select(movie, everything())

lotr_tidy
```
